title: Where Glovebox runs
subtitle: The Docker stack (gate, standins, seed) for throwaway and Linux test; on the Mac mini, native test under launchd beside operator-only production

nodes.label: seed
nodes.sub: Compose job: writes the fixture cast

evidence.note: main() dispatches the subcommands that build_parser registers (line 873 on). TIERS at line 56 names throwaway and test only: env.py does not deploy or manage production.
Runs seed.py as root in the container to own the state volume; profile tools keeps it out of a plain up, so env.py runs it by name.
Named volume state, mounted at /state by the stand-ins and the seed job. Only the Docker stack uses it; the native test tier keeps its own copy in nstate.
Healthcheck at line 71 passes only once every listener has the seeded cast; listeners answer 503 before (deploy/standins/standins.py:44).
Built from deploy/Dockerfile.gate. compose.test.yaml adds restart: unless-stopped and a fixed loopback port on the Linux test tier; the throwaway tier gets a free loopback port.

Three system LaunchDaemons as glovebox-test, with no GUI login. glovebox.test.standins.plist has the same shape (line 11); glovebox.test.ensure-test.plist runs env.py ensure-test at load and then every 300 s (line 39). The gate and stand-ins are native: env.py's service_plan (line 292) starts glovebox serve --bootstrap-fixture and standins.py from the checkout's virtualenv, against the seeded fixture.
SEED_STATE, under the checkout's gitignored .run directory and owned by glovebox-test. It is separate from the Compose volume state: the native test tier runs no Docker.

A LaunchAgent, not a daemon, because production reads Messages in frogger's GUI session. The operator installs it by hand (docs/environments.md, production runbook); env.py and the test daemons never install, load or manage it. It starts the plain glovebox command, with no --bootstrap-fixture.

The shell sources the secrets file named by @SECRETS@ and execs the gate; no tool in the repository reads or writes it. The gate opens ~/Library/Messages/chat.db read-only (src/glovebox/chatdb.py:119).
seed(): docker compose run --rm --no-deps seed, called from command_up (line 570).
The seed service mounts fixtures read-only and the state volume read-write.
The shared x-standin anchor mounts the state volume; standins.py reads it from STANDINS_STATE (line 83).
The gate starts only once standins is healthy, and reaches it by name through the GLOVEBOX_STANDIN_* URLs (line 41 on).
Starts the Docker stack and waits for the healthchecks; depends_on brings standins up first.
native_seed() runs deploy/standins/seed.py into SEED_STATE, for up and reset on the native test backend. No Compose volume is involved.
service_plan sets STANDINS_STATE to SEED_STATE for the native stand-ins, which read it on every request.

ProgramArguments: env.py serve gate --tier test; serve (env.py:493) keeps one process alive while the desired-state file asks for it. glovebox.test.ensure-test.plist:20 runs env.py ensure-test, which brings the test stack to origin/main (env.py:759).
set -a; . "$1"; set +a; exec "$2", with the secrets file and .venv/bin/glovebox as arguments.
